landlock-linux-only.reason: SandboxIsolationTest uses Linux Landlock and skips on macOS. The same tests must run and pass on the Linux CI lane recorded under M10.1.

laravel-ai-pre-v1-fallback.reason: Two tests cover the fallback when an installed laravel/ai lacks the decide capability. composer.json requires laravel/ai ^1.0, which always has it, so the tests skip. They stay in the suite so a future constraint change re-enables them.
tests: DetectLaravelAiClassificationTest: does not treat structured-agent support as decide support
ClassificationAdapterTest: uses fallback capability detection when Laravel AI lacks the decide capability

no-application-source-index.reason: The frozen launch contract does not include indexing application source. docs/project-graph.md states that application source is not indexed, so there are no application call edges to mark unresolved. Mary's MVP completion prompt of 2026-09-28 says not to build a new PHP application-source index only to satisfy an imported requirement.

amendments.change: Prelaunch acceptance runs the documented 'Install a prelaunch candidate' commands. The public registry install line is checked after publication under MME-5341.
amendments.reason: The public line (^0.2 from the GitHub VCS repository) cannot resolve until a 0.2 release is tagged, and tagging is not authorized before human prelaunch review. The MME-5885 handoff keeps public-registry installation as a postpublication check and forbids a circular dependency on publication.
